id: title:charlesvien:log why every notification sound plays

review.posthog_relevance: Adds structured, reason-tagged logging and metadata to the Desktop app's notification and completion sound subsystems, aiding debugging and support for the Desktop product.
review.reason: The change adds a `reason` field and optional `debug` metadata to `NotificationDescriptor` and its callers, and records structured, reason-tagged log entries for every notification. observations.behavior: Adds a helper function describeSoundUrl to distinguish built-in sounds from custom ones, and its result is logged.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a structured log entry identifying the sound source, distinguishing between built-in and custom sounds, and including the playback reason. This aids debugging and support for the Desktop product's completion sound feature.

observations.behavior: Adds a parameter reason to playCompletionSound and its value is passed to the completion sound log and the error log.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows distinguishing why a completion sound was triggered, which could help diagnose why a sound played or failed in the Desktop app.

observations.behavior: Adds a warning log entry when audio.play fails, including the resolved sound and reason.
